releaseNotes:
v0.3.442

- Windows WPF build error CS1061 in `Models/ChatMessage.cs`.
- `FormattedText.HeightIncludingTrailingWhitespace` is not a valid WPF `FormattedText` property.
- Replaced it with supported `FormattedText.Height`.
- No feature/version behavior change.
- Keeps v0.3.442.
- Compact chat full-view threshold still uses measured text height with the configured line height and width.
- Existing v0.3.442 UI changes remain intact.
